# Tenxora.Services

> AI-assisted business services, reviewed by people. Tenxora.Services helps English-speaking businesses worldwide plan, implement and improve Odoo. AI and code prepare the initial work; people review it before customer approval. Odoo services are available today.

Tenxora.Services is an AI-assisted Service as a Software company. Your team approves the business workflows before an agreed production handover. Only Odoo services are offered at the moment; other services are not yet available.

- Founder: Bilal Mashkoor
- Founded: 2026
- Team: 15 people
- Business address: 4th Floor, Interlace Plaza, I-8 Markaz, Islamabad 44000, Pakistan
- Telephone: +92 336 5188711
- Email: contact@tenxora.services

## Odoo services

- [Odoo implementation](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/implementation/): For a new rollout or a defined next phase: agree processes, configure the relevant applications, prepare data and test the workflows your team needs.
- [Odoo consulting and workflow review](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/consulting/): For unclear requirements or an existing setup that needs direction: assess fit, identify gaps and turn competing requests into a prioritized delivery plan.
- [AI-assisted implementation](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/ai-assisted-implementation/): How AI and code prepare initial work and people review it against the agreed requirements.
- [Integrations](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/integration/): Connect Odoo with other systems and improve an existing setup.
- [Data migration](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/migration/): Moving data into Odoo.
- [Customization](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/customization/): Adapting Odoo to how the business works.
- [Implementation costs](https://tenxora.services/odoo-services/implementation-cost/): What an Odoo implementation costs.
